svg.title: Walking-time penalty of the slopes to the nearest school and health unit, Salvador
svg.desc: Two maps of Salvador covered by hexagons coloured by the minutes that slopes add to the walk to the nearest public school, on the left, and primary health care unit, on the right.

g.text: Walking time to the nearest unit with Tobler's slope costs, minus the time on flat ground
(500 m cells, Censo 2022; Copernicus DEM GLO-90). For 32% of the residents the walk to a
health unit is 2 minutes or more longer
Minutes the slopes add on foot, Salvador
Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Geofabrik extract of 2026-11-01. Elevation: Copernicus DEM
GLO-90 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by
the European Union and ESA. Boundaries and population: IBGE, Censo 2022. Schools: INEP. Health units: CNES.
